risks.title: Intense competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition is intense with numerous competitors possessing sophisticated product portfolios and advanced technological capabilities. This could lead to reduced sales and profitability.

risks.title: Economic and market risks
risks.score_rationale: Economic, political, and market conditions may negatively impact the company's results. Fluctuations in interest rates, consumer confidence, employment levels, and price stability can all affect the company.

risks.title: Supply chain risks
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions may negatively impact the company's results. Conflicts, natural disasters, and product quality issues can all affect the company.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulations and laws may negatively impact the company's results. Product bans or ingredient restrictions can all affect the company.

risks.title: Credit risks
risks.score_rationale: Credit market disruptions may negatively impact the company's results. Fluctuations in interest rates and restrictions on access to credit can all affect the company.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity attacks may negatively impact the company's results. Data losses and operational disruptions can all affect the company.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical conflicts and tensions may negatively impact the company's results. Trade restrictions and supply chain disruptions can all affect the company.

risks.title: Customer consolidation risks
risks.score_rationale: Customer consolidation may negatively impact the company's results. Larger customers may have greater bargaining power and could demand lower prices.

ai_positioning.summary: Company SXT does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
